title: Deletion of 6 Veterinary Biological Monographs from forthcoming edition of Indian Pharmacopoeia
bodyHtml:
Deletion of 6 Veterinary Biological Monographs from forthcoming edition of Indian Pharmacopoeia (i.e. IP-2018), which is given below:-

  1. Brucella Melitensis (Strain Rev. 1) Vaccine, Live
  2. Canine Adenovirus Vaccine, Inactivated
  3. Canine Adenovirus Vaccine, Live
  4. Canine Contagious Hepatitis Vaccine, Live
  5. Old Adjuvant Vaccine Against Pasturellosis in Sheep and Goats
  6. Rinderpest Vaccine, Live
